name: Language interoperability
description: Ownership and runtime coordination across C++ and Python. Prerequisites: C++ lifetime, references and threads; basic Python functions and objects. This application subject owns domain concepts; the C++ course owns language syntax, lifetime rules and standard-library mechanisms.
